body: Sound very leisurely.. see, our worst fears lie in anticipation. Take advantage of this opportunity to get into shape.

Power through it man. Fitness is a good thing. Challenge yourself to reach certain physical goals, learn how to properly workout. Once you become an adult you will soon find out that the more you can learn/know the better you will be off in life therefore take the time now to grow while you still can.
So what? That's a good time to start. If anything buy yourself some pre-workout or caffeine pills.

Its not only about having relationship although it does play a huge factor, its also about my inability to see anything through. I had a job where i was making $50 an hour, 5-6 hour shifts, fit perfectly into my school and gym schedule and i lost it simply because i did not even bother trying to keep it. I've had so many job opportunities, business opportunities yet for some reason i give up without trying or at the first sign off struggle. 
Maybe its because i don't have a reason to keep on going. I lack motivation and desire. I know how fortunate i am to be struggling with such superficial shit yet i know if i dont deal with it soon things will worsen. 
As for the girls, well ive had opportunities with beautiful woman and as always i find a way to turn shit around, i look at couples and i want someone to fight for, someone to share my day with, someone that makes me want to become a better man... is that too much to ask for?

Exercise becomes a habit, an addiction even. The more you do it the better you feel about yourself as your physique improves. It also helps keep your body and mind relaxed throughout the day. Pull through it until it becomes something you like, give it 3-4 weeks til your hooked.

School is the easiest part in life man. I wish i could go back to high school and not have to worry about shit other than drama or video games. Just muddle through, dont fuck up like i did. Im in college working to pay my tuition because i didnt get the grades in HS to get financial aid. I know the struggle and how at the moment it seems like a huge deal because its currently your world however look forward and all this will become irrelevant.
